name: Veigar
passive_desc: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

VeigarBalefulStrike.name: Baleful Strike
VeigarBalefulStrike.tooltip:
Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage to the first two enemies hit.

If Veigar kills an enemy with this Ability, he gains @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil. Large minions and large monsters grant @Spell.VeigarPassive:dQKillStacksLarge@ stacks instead.
VeigarBalefulStrike.summary: Veigar unleashes a bolt of dark energy that deals magic damage to the first two enemies hit. Units killed by this bolt grant Veigar some ability power permanently.

VeigarPassive.name: Phenomenal Evil Power
VeigarPassive.tooltip:
Veigar's Abilities grant him @dAbilityStacks@ stack of Phenomenal Evil when they strike enemy champions. Takedowns on champions grant an additional @dTakedownStacks@ stacks.

Each stack of Phenomenal Evil grants Veigar @APPerStack@ Ability Power.
VeigarPassive.summary: Veigar is the greatest Evil to ever strike at the hearts of Runeterra - and he's only getting bigger! Striking an enemy Champion with a spell or scoring a takedown grants Veigar permanently increased Ability Power.

VeigarEventHorizon.name: Event Horizon
VeigarEventHorizon.tooltip: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that <status>Stuns</status> enemies that pass through for @StunDuration@ seconds. The cage lasts for 3 seconds.
VeigarEventHorizon.summary: Veigar twists the edges of space, creating a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.

VeigarDarkMatter.name: Dark Matter
VeigarDarkMatter.tooltip:
Veigar summons dark matter from the sky, dealing @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Every @Spell.VeigarPassive:PStacksPerDarkMatterCDR@ stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce this Ability's Cooldown by @Spell.VeigarPassive:DarkMatterCDRIncrement*100@%.
VeigarDarkMatter.summary: Veigar calls a great mass of dark matter to fall from the sky to the target location, dealing magic damage when it lands. Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown.

VeigarR.name: Primordial Burst
VeigarR.tooltip: Veigar blasts an enemy champion with primal magic to deal between <magicDamage>@MinDamage@ and @MaxDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>, increasing with the target's missing Health. Damage is maximized against enemies below 33% Health.
VeigarR.summary: Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.
